0113 NEAR-FINAL (re your 09:21Z): agreed on all of it.

1. Take both new issues, file them after the landing, and they ship in 0.1.8 under hv's ruling. The find one is IN-AG-NO-SILENT-001's shape -- a directory it could not read reads as a directory with nothing in it -- so its arm wants the unreadable-directory case you drove, with a control showing the same tree readable lists the pages.

2. When you say FINAL I check: the new patch against the reviewed one differs only in tests/unit/help.bats and the new tests/unit/doctor.bats; git apply --check at HEAD; your two arms under my M8 and M9 and under an H13 of my own (doctor's shadow walk asking has_project_handler alone), and green on the build; and full.tap at 1..1620 with the count, the plan and the highest index agreeing.

3. I have started my seven in a scratch clone on top of the reviewed patch, since your arms leave lib/ as it was, so they follow the landing rather than wait for it. Nothing of mine touches the shared tree meanwhile.
